fruits.name: Apple
fruits.history: Believed to have originated in Central Asia and cultivated for thousands of years.

fruits.name: Banana
fruits.history: One of the oldest cultivated fruits, first domesticated in Southeast Asia.

fruits.name: Mango
fruits.history: Known as the 'King of Fruits' and cultivated in India for over 4,000 years.

fruits.name: Orange
fruits.history: Sweet oranges were first cultivated in ancient China.

fruits.name: Pineapple
fruits.history: Native to South America and spread globally by explorers.

fruits.name: Grapes
fruits.history: Cultivated for over 8,000 years for food and beverages.

fruits.name: Papaya
fruits.history: Native to Central America and widely cultivated in tropical regions.

fruits.name: Guava
fruits.history: Introduced from Central America to many tropical countries.

fruits.name: Watermelon
fruits.history: Cultivated in Africa thousands of years ago.

fruits.name: Strawberry
fruits.history: The modern strawberry originated from a hybrid developed in Europe.

fruits.name: Kiwi
fruits.history: Originally known as the Chinese gooseberry before becoming popular in New Zealand.

fruits.name: Pear
fruits.history: Cultivated in Europe for over 3,000 years.

fruits.name: Peach
fruits.history: Peaches originated in China and spread via the Silk Road.

fruits.name: Plum
fruits.history: Plums have been cultivated since ancient Roman times.

fruits.name: Cherry
fruits.history: Named after the ancient city of Cerasus in modern-day Turkey.

fruits.name: Pomegranate
fruits.history: One of the oldest cultivated fruits in the Middle East.

fruits.name: Lemon
fruits.history: Believed to have originated in India before spreading worldwide.

fruits.name: Lime
fruits.history: Used by sailors to prevent scurvy because of its vitamin C content.

fruits.name: Dragon Fruit
fruits.history: Originally native to Central America and now widely cultivated in Asia.

fruits.name: Lychee
fruits.history: Lychee has been cultivated in China for more than 2,000 years.

fruits.name: Jackfruit
fruits.history: Native to India and cultivated throughout South and Southeast Asia.

fruits.name: Custard Apple
fruits.history: Spread from the Americas to Asia by Spanish and Portuguese traders.

fruits.name: Sapodilla
fruits.history: Known for producing chicle, once used to make chewing gum.

fruits.name: Star Fruit
fruits.history: Named after its distinctive star-shaped cross-section.

fruits.name: Passion Fruit
fruits.history: Named by Spanish missionaries because the flower symbolized the Passion of Christ.

fruits.name: Fig
fruits.history: One of the earliest cultivated fruit trees in human history.

fruits.name: Mulberry
fruits.history: Mulberry leaves are the primary food source for silkworms.

fruits.name: Coconut
fruits.history: Known as the 'Tree of Life' because nearly every part is useful.

fruits.name: Avocado
fruits.history: Cultivated in Central America for over 5,000 years.

fruits.name: Rambutan
fruits.history: The name 'Rambutan' comes from the Malay word 'rambut', meaning hair.

fruits.name: Blackberry
fruits.history: Consumed since ancient Greek and Roman times.

fruits.name: Blueberry
fruits.history: Native Americans used blueberries for food and medicine.

fruits.name: Cranberry
fruits.history: Traditionally harvested in bogs in North America.

fruits.name: Gooseberry
fruits.history: Cultivated across Europe since the Middle Ages.

fruits.name: Indian Gooseberry (Amla)
fruits.history: Widely used in Ayurvedic medicine for centuries.

fruits.name: Durian
fruits.history: Known as the 'King of Fruits' in Southeast Asia.

fruits.name: Mangosteen
fruits.history: Often called the 'Queen of Fruits'.

fruits.name: Longan
fruits.history: Known as the 'Dragon Eye Fruit' because of its appearance.

fruits.name: Pomelo
fruits.history: The largest citrus fruit and an ancestor of grapefruit.

fruits.name: Grapefruit
fruits.history: Believed to have originated as a natural hybrid between pomelo and sweet orange.

fruits.name: Apricot
fruits.history: Cultivated in China for over 4,000 years before spreading westward.

fruits.name: Persimmon
fruits.history: Known as the 'Divine Fruit' in many Asian cultures.

fruits.name: Tamarind
fruits.history: Widely used in Indian, Thai, and Mexican cuisines.

fruits.name: Date
fruits.history: Cultivated for over 6,000 years in the Middle East.

fruits.name: Olive
fruits.history: A symbol of peace and prosperity in ancient civilizations.

fruits.name: Breadfruit
fruits.history: Introduced to the Caribbean in the 18th century.

fruits.name: Soursop
fruits.history: Popular in the Caribbean and South America.

fruits.name: Loquat
fruits.history: Cultivated in China for over 1,000 years.

fruits.name: Jujube
fruits.history: Used in traditional Chinese medicine for thousands of years.

fruits.name: Salak (Snake Fruit)
fruits.history: Named 'snake fruit' because of its reddish-brown scaly skin.

fruits.name: Ackee
fruits.history: Introduced from West Africa to Jamaica in the 18th century.

fruits.name: Bael
fruits.history: A sacred fruit in Hinduism associated with Lord Shiva.

fruits.name: Bilberry
fruits.history: Used in European herbal medicine for centuries.

fruits.name: Boysenberry
fruits.history: Developed in California in the 1920s.

fruits.name: Canistel
fruits.history: Also called Egg Fruit because of its texture.

fruits.name: Cloudberry
fruits.history: Highly valued in Scandinavian countries.

fruits.name: Feijoa
fruits.history: Named after Portuguese naturalist João da Silva Feijó.

fruits.name: Goji Berry
fruits.history: Used in traditional Chinese medicine for more than 2,000 years.

fruits.name: Huckleberry
fruits.history: Popular in the Pacific Northwest of North America.

fruits.name: Java Apple
fruits.history: Also known as Wax Apple or Water Apple in many countries.
